question: Whose autobiography is titled ‘Ace against Odds’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sania Mirza**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sania Mirza** is the author of the autobiography titled 'Ace against Odds'.
 
• The book was published in July 2016 and chronicles her journey as a professional tennis player.
 
• Sania Mirza is one of India's most successful female tennis players, having won several Grand Slam titles and achieving the World No. 1 ranking in doubles.
 
• The autobiography provides insights into her personal and professional life, including her struggles and triumphs in the world of tennis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sania Mirza** was born on 15th November 1986 in Mumbai, India.
 
• She has been honored with several awards, including the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna.
 
• In addition to her tennis career, Sania Mirza is also known for her philanthropic work and has been a strong advocate for women's rights and empowerment.
 
• The title 'Ace against Odds' reflects her ability to overcome the challenges and obstacles she faced throughout her career.
